privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: Bio-Dosha-12 stores your health-related information only to calculate your body balance and give recommendations.
privacy.collect: Name, email and a hashed password; each profile's birth date, sex, height, constitution type and Kt coefficient; weight, season, BEDI calculation history and recommendations. In practitioner mode, a patient's national register number, phone, address, intake records and treatment log are stored.
privacy.use: The data is used only to calculate your BEDI index, deviation and recommendations, show your history, and produce practitioner reports. It is never sold or used for advertising.
privacy.access: Only you can see your profiles and calculations. Patient records entered by a practitioner are visible only to that practitioner. Admins see user names and emails to decide practitioner access requests.
privacy.delete: You can delete family profiles on the Family page. A practitioner can permanently delete all of a patient's data from the patient page. To delete your whole account, contact the system owner.
privacy.security: Connections are encrypted with HTTPS. Passwords are stored as one-way bcrypt hashes. Sign-in attempts are rate limited and sessions expire after 12 hours.
